test_fake_jit: test fake_jit context manager to enable or disable JIT patching for JAX functions
test_fake_pmap: test fake_pmap context manager to enable or disable pmap patching for JAX functions
test_fake_pmap_and_jit: test fake_pmap_and_jit context manager to simultaneously control both pmap and jit patching
test_on_call_of_transformed_function: test OnCallOfTransformedFunction context manager to count how many times jax.jit is called
test_set_n_cpu_devices: test set_n_cpu_devices to configure the number of CPU devices for fake pmap tests
